data.name: Don’t Let Them Drive
data.detailed_description:
Your city has a problem.

It’s not zombies.
It’s not aliens.
It’s not a mysterious fog.

It’s drunk people.

In this chaotic co-op game, waves of heavily intoxicated NPCs spill into the city and begin their heroic journey toward their cars. Your job is simple: stop them from getting there. If even one drunk reaches their vehicle and drives home, the entire team pays the price.

Work together with friends to intercept, block, distract, and outplay an ever-growing crowd of wobbling citizens determined to make terrible decisions. Each wave brings more drunks, worse coordination, and increasingly questionable pathfinding. Between waves, you’ll get a short moment to breathe… before the countdown hits zero and the next disaster begins.


The Goal

Prevent the drunks from reaching their cars.
That’s it.

If they time out, you’re safe, if they reach the hotel, you’re safe.
If they drive home… you weren’t good enough.


Features

  • Co-op chaos – Coordinate with up to 4 friends or yell at them when things inevitably go wrong

  • Escalating waves – One drunk becomes two, two become ten, and suddenly nobody is okay

  • Shared failure – One mistake affects everyone. Blame accordingly

  • Physics, pathfinding, and poor life choices

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD / AMD Vega or better)
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Designed to run on low-end PCs especially with today’s GPU prices
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU recommended, but not required
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: any
  • Additional Notes: Designed to run on low-end PCs especially with today’s GPU prices
